hotels.title: Playful Design-Led Zurich Stay by Mama Shelter
hotels.description: Step into playful Parisian flair in Zurich’s lively Oerlikon district, where bold design, curated art and retro-chic interiors define this contemporary retreat. Just moments from Hallenstadion and Messe Zürich, the hotel places concerts, exhibitions and business addresses within easy reach. Mornings begin with generous breakfasts, while the restaurant serves French-inspired plates and Swiss favourites in a vibrant setting. Nearby, leafy MFO-Park and the boutiques, cafés and galleries of Zurich West offer a stylish counterpoint to the city’s storied Old Town
